# Release Notes: v1.0.13

> This file is the source of truth for the GitHub Release body.
> The release workflow (`.github/workflows/release-android.yml`)
> copies this file's contents as the Release body via `body_path`.

## Android

- **Undo no longer hides Close tracking day** — after you logged something,
  the Undo pill floated over the bottom of the Track screen for 5 seconds and
  covered the **Close tracking day** button. It now has its own space below
  the list, so nothing is covered (#153)
